name: local-provider-empty-scope
title: sd-review reports an all-excluded local diff as a provider failure
description: A local review provider handed a diff whose every path its configuration excludes exits 0 with no structured report, and the sd-review coordinator records that as a provider failure. The failure then blocks remote routing, and because an absent optional router requires a clean local receipt, no combination of local= and remote= controls can complete the review stage. Observed on PR #339, whose four changed paths were all under .trellis/tasks/ while .gito/config.toml excluded .trellis/** wholesale. Give an all-excluded scope its own typed outcome that does not fail closed, without letting a genuine provider failure through.
